marta_ae: Heads up — GoldenField (agritech startup) requesting an extended starter grant for a campus pilot with 4 universities. They want 160k free tokens + tiered overage discount. Any fast-track?

eli_se: Tech note: they'll need hashed telemetry, KMS, and short-lived test keys for integrations. Expect bursts during harvest demos.

tori_dealdesk: policy: standard grant 50k, >100k needs DealDesk approval + legal review. Provide proposed terms and USD exposure.

marta_ae: Proposed: 160k grant upfront, 3-month ramp: 200k, 400k, 800k tokens; overage at 20% off public rate; single rollover allowed into month 4; require milestone SOW with weekly check-ins.

opsbot: automated: "Promo >100k requires DealDesk ticket and legal review."

tori_dealdesk: okay — action items: (1) marta_ae send rough $ exposure at public rates, (2) eli_se estimate infra surcharge if VPC needed, (3) nina_cs draft 6-week onboarding milestones. If finance/legal okay, DealDesk can approve 160k one-time grant and the 20% overage discount. One-line anti-abuse clause required in SOW.

nina_cs: will draft milestone template and guardrails.

marta_ae: I'll push customer to sign SOW with milestones. Please flag ticket if you need early promo code.

tori_dealdesk: creating ticket DD-2026-4999. Marking for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
